description: [narrowed from route-edit-861bc804] In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/goal-target-inference.ts, change the substring 'Return the 1-3 shapes from the KNOWN list whose production best satisfies the goal. Also provide a confidence value' to 'Return the 1-6 shapes from the KNOWN list whose production best satisfies the goal. Also provide a confidence value'. That exact substring occurs exactly once in the file. This is the PRIMARY instruction in the goal-routing prompt and it is what caps compositional depth: the model is told to return at most three target shapes, so a goal genuinely requiring four or more distinct output shapes is silently truncated and the resulting composition is shallower than the goal requires. A previous edit raised only the ALTERNATIVES clause and left this primary clause untouched, so the ceiling did not move. Nonce prompt-primary-6b1c.
